releases.displayName: The Coma 3: Bloodlines Demo Has Been Updated!

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45766856/8b7ab7b9c040b6e814ab37f89bb6d92d6030aecb.jpg"]
Looking for a good way to introduce a friend to The Coma series? Or still wondering if The Coma 3: Bloodlines is the right nightmare for you?
Our demo has been updated!

The previous demo was built around an earlier stage of development. We've now brought it up to date with the released version of the game, making it easier for newcomers to understand what's happening, follow the story, and get a better feel for the experience.

If you've already played the full game, this update probably won't change much for you. But if you've been meaning to introduce The Coma 3 to a friend, or if you're still on the fence about playing it yourself, now's a great time to give it a try!
Thanks for supporting The Coma series, and don't forget to share the demo with a friend who could use a little more horror in their life.
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/4310990/The_Coma_3_Bloodlines_Demo/?beta=1"]
See you in the shadows!
— Dvora Studio

releases.displayName: The Coma 3: Dark Song Character Skin DLC and Deluxe Edition Update

items.text: [img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45766856/45da79d0904abb9ed05bc17b2e3976cad3f55bee.png"]
Dear Ghost Vigilantes,

We’ve got some exciting news for you, especially for all the Jihyun fans and completionists! A new character skin DLC just dropped and it is none other than your favorite creepy teacher from the Coma-franchise: Dark Song!
And, of course, this new DLC is going to be added to the Coma 3: Bloodlines Deluxe Edition bundle as well. But wait a second: What about players that already purchased the Deluxe Edition bundle?

Don’t worry, we’ve got you covered! You can simply head to the store page of the Coma 3: Bloodlines Deluxe Edition bundle and purchase the new Dark Song skin DLC there. This way, the general discount for the bundle’s items will be applied to the Dark Song skin DLC as well:
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/bundle/68163/The_Coma_3_Bloodlines__Deluxe_Edition/"]
IMPORTANT: This discount won’t be taken into account if you purchase the DLC as a single item on its individual DLC store page!

New DLCs that are added to a “Complete The Set”-bundle, like our Deluxe Edition, simply mark this bundle as “incomplete” again. The proper discounts on missing items to complete the bundle will be applied to those items through the bundle’s respective store page as well. So, if you own the Deluxe Edition already, make sure you don’t miss out on that sweet discount there!
See you in Dark Song’s classroom, friends!
Minho, Dvora Studio, Headup & Thermite Games
[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3885590/The_Coma_3_Bloodlines/"]
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45766856/21346c3f0e2580fe42c4d2e8c6ff09af7e200f8c.jpg"]
Hello, Ghost Vigilantes!

As the weather gets warmer, there’s truly nothing better than cooling down with a spine-chilling horror game. We want to express our deepest gratitude for your continuous love and support for The Coma 3: Bloodlines.
Today, we have deployed Patch v1.1.8 to address a few critical issues from the previous build and expand our language support. Please see the full details below:

Academy Pursuit Glitch Fixed: Resolved an issue introduced in v1.1.7 where enemy characters would occasionally run in place under specific conditions during pursuit sequences in the Academy scene. The Boss is now properly back on the hunt!
Skin Functionality Stabilized: Implemented stability updates for the Jihyun - Dark Song skin to ensure smoother gameplay and prevent potential mechanical or visual glitches.
Localization & Text Polish: Fixed minor translation errors and text display bugs across various languages to improve overall readability.
Vietnamese Language Added: We are thrilled to announce that Vietnamese is now officially supported! A warm welcome to all our Vietnamese players entering the Shadow Realm.
— Minho Kim,
Dvora Studio.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45766856/29d0edfdb9cbcbbbabe535ac0a266476a9975d2e.jpg"]
Hello, Ghost Vigilantes!

We have just deployed a new update to improve your survival experience in The Coma 3: Bloodlines. This patch focuses on adding new language support, addressing progression issues, and refining gameplay balance.
Spanish Language Added: The game now supports Spanish translation. You can update your language preferences in the settings menu.

Video Playback Fail-safe: Fixed an issue where a video playback failure could block your progress. Now, if a video fails to play, an error message will appear, and you will be able to skip the segment to continue playing.
Camera Direction Polishing in certain events: Adjusted the camera presentation and framing in certain sections to enhance the atmosphere and visual flow.
Level Design Adjustments: Modified the level design in specific areas to improve pacing and exploration. (Especially on the Department Store.)
Puzzle Interaction Areas: Adjusted the control/interaction detection zones for certain puzzles to make them more responsive and intuitive.
Enemy Behavior: Improved enemy state transitions for smoother AI behavior during encounters.
Gamepad Options Navigation: Fixed a bug where certain items within the Options UI could not be selected or controlled when playing with a gamepad.
Stay safe out there in the dark!
— Minho Kim
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45766856/677fb6c3c4c91a399a98b8015876f047e9606ece.png"]
1.1.6 Patch Notes

Hello, Ghost Vigilantes! This is Dvora Studio. We have prepared a patch based on the work we’ve completed over the past week. This update includes ongoing optimization and major fixes for the behavior patterns of Roamers, which many of you have mentioned as a significant concern.
Optimization Updates
An option to toggle Bloom on and off has been added.

An Error Message feature has been added for game crashes (such as black screens or freezes). This will help us identify exactly which category of issue is causing the game to stop. After tracking the reports submitted so far, we have narrowed down the potential causes to a few factors. While reports of these issues have decreased since version 1.1.5 due to extensive optimization, we will continue to monitor the situation closely.

A loading screen has been added to the initial game startup before entering the main menu. Since loading speeds vary by device, the black screen during loading often led players to mistakenly believe the game had crashed.
Gameplay Updates
Fixed an issue where loading save data during combat would sometimes result in an immediate death right after the game loaded.

Improved the behavior of Roamers so they no longer rush and attack players while the character is still in the middle of a movement animation. We acknowledge that this was an unfair mechanic and have corrected it in the 1.1.6 patch.
The quest item required to save Jihyun have been improved, as many players found them too well-hidden or easy to miss.

Fixed a phenomenon where enemies appeared to enter from the opposite direction when entering certain areas. 8. Fixed an issue where enemies would disappear after reaching the source of a noise they were investigating.
Achievement Updates
Fixed a bug where Steam achievements were not updating correctly in certain environments during version 1.1.5 gameplay.
Additional In-Game Content
Fixed functional errors in the Jukebox UI.

We are monitoring all your words of encouragement and constructive feedback provided with such interest and affection. We will continue to release updates to improve the game wherever possible. (Currently, including 2B) Thank you for your support.
Best,
Minho Kim,
Dvora Studio
Hello, Ghost Vigilantes,

this is Dvora Studio again. This patch focuses on items that are prioritized for their importance rather than urgency, which is why we conducted extensive internal playtesting. Below are the details for Patch 1.1.5, and we hope these updates improve your gaming experience.
Fixed an issue where all items, not just restricted ones, could not be moved in the quick slots and inventory when playing as Mina.
Fixed the positioning of certain elements on some map UIs that were displayed differently from their actual locations.
Fixed resolution-related bugs that occurred when switching between devices (such as PC and Steam Deck).
Reduced the loading time on the black screen after the logo by half when launching the game on Steam Deck.
Adjusted the 2nd round of the boss fight with Hwaju so that new enemies will not be summoned until the current ones are defeated. (This prevents enemies from continuously stacking up.)

Adjusted the 1st + 2nd round of the boss fight with Hwaju so that players can loot health recovery items. This addresses the feedback that many players were unable to prepare for the difficulty because they didn't know when the boss fight would start and couldn't visit the shop in time.
Fixed an issue where the game behaved abnormally when attempting to load a save at the exact moment of a Game Over.
Fixed several typos in the Korean text.
Fixed issues where incorrect portraits were displayed in some dialogues and corrected various in-game icons that were not shown as intended.

Through multiple playtests, we believe the battle with Hwaju has become much smoother than before without becoming too easy, but we are very curious to hear your thoughts. We hope this patch proves helpful to your overall gaming experience. Thank you for your continued support and interest.
Minho Kim,
Dvora Studio.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45766856/9e9c782406c37c0286714dc51b9391bd08eb8b8d.png"]

Hello, we are currently working hard to fix the issues gathered over the weekend. Although there are consecutive holidays in Korea and Europe making things a bit difficult, we are trying our best to respond quickly to your feedback and problems. Below are the details of the update.

Trap range adjustments and VFX improvements – We received feedback that the damage range for Poison and Slow was too wide and hard to see clearly. We have slightly reduced the range, and for Poison Gas, we enhanced the visuals so players can clearly tell, "I shouldn't go there."

Fixed an issue where Steam achievements would not update if the save data (especially from the demo) already had the achievement cleared – This also fixes the issue where the first achievement would not trigger in the full game after playing the demo.
Restored full health when entering the second phase of the Boss4 (Hwaju) battle – You no longer have to struggle through the second phase with zero energy due to a previous save.
Fixed an issue where sound would not play in certain cutscenes under specific conditions.
Fixed translation issues for Russian Steam achievements.
Improved some of the Thai in-game translations.
Restored the "Single Encrypted Page" in the Artbook DLC.
The following issues are already known to the development team, and we are testing various ways to fix them.

Game freezing on a black screen due to abnormal RAM usage in certain environments - Compared to our previous titles, this game requires more RAM. While we understand it is difficult to perfectly optimize the game for every user's local environment, we are currently researching and testing ways to prevent excessive RAM usage and ensure the game does not freeze in these situations.
Progression issues after the logo video when the game is installed on a drive other than C:
Issues where some enemies behave abnormally.
Occasional issues where Mina's quick slots cannot be controlled.

Slow video loading in certain environments (especially at startup) – For example, taking a long time before the main menu appears. Specifically, on Steam Deck, the logo video sometimes takes too long to load. We have identified the cause, but since it is difficult to fix immediately, we are working on resolving it step by step.
We sincerely apologize to those who experienced these issues for the interruption to your gaming experience. We will continue to put our best effort into securing and improving the game. Thank you.
Best regards,
Minho Kim,
Dvora Studio

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45766856/4ae403d0286a4e61e9b37b59b339168c67075f1e.png"]

Thank you so much for your interest in this series and for playing the game within its universe. Although we tested the game across various device environments, unlike previous titles, The Coma 3 features rich visual implementation and real-time calculations. Therefore, the playing experience may vary depending on your hardware. We would like to sincerely apologize to anyone experiencing stuttering or frame drops during gameplay.
The following is a list of updates, similar to a HotFix, addressing issues reported by many players:
1. Fixed Donut Head Freezing Issue in the Apartment Chapter

This was an issue we couldn't replicate during several internal tests, but quite a few players experienced it and had to reload because the "Donut Man" was blocking the path. We have identified the cause and fixed it.
2. PlayStation Controller Input Fix
We recognized some issues with PlayStation controller inputs and have applied a fix.
3. Modified Stalker Puzzle Clues in the Apartment Chapter

We have updated the puzzle clues that received feedback saying, "Every other puzzle makes sense, but this one doesn't!" Players going through this section now, or those starting the game for the first time after this patch, will be able to play without major confusion or stress.
4. Added Thai & Russian Achievements
We thought we had included everything, but they were missing. They have now been properly added.
We've received reports that achievements aren't unlocking for some players using demo save data. It's a known issue, and we expect to apply a fix after the holiday break.

Thank you for all your support, encouragement, and interest. While most players may not experience these technical issues, we feel truly sorry for those who couldn't fully enjoy the game due to lag or stuttering. We are closely monitoring and reviewing the game's optimization. Thank you.
Best regards, Minho Kim
